name: images
title: Images
description: Compress, resize, convert, rotate, crop, strip metadata, make an icon set, read the text: the images selected in Finder, on the clipboard or at a typed path, with the tools on the machine (sips, pngquant, oxipng, mozjpeg, cwebp, avifenc, ImageMagick) and TinyPNG when you give it a key. Every result lands next to its source with a suffix, its path copied.
author: pal

settings.label: Replace the original
settings.text: Write the result over the source instead of next to it (a copy is kept for Restore original)

settings.label: Quality
settings.description: For the lossy encoders (JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, pngquant's floor is 25 below it).

settings.label: Web format
settings.description: What Optimise for web writes: the source's format, or WebP or AVIF.

settings.label: Web size cap
settings.description: Optimise for web shrinks the long side to at most this many pixels; smaller images are left at their size.

settings.label: Thumbnails
settings.text: Show a thumbnail on each row and in the detail pane (sips or ImageMagick, cached)

settings.label: Pad colour
settings.description: What Pad to a square fills with, as hex.

settings.label: TinyPNG API key
settings.description: From tinypng.com/developers (500 compressions a month free). Adds Compress with TinyPNG to every row.

settings.label: Tools
settings.description: The encoders in the order they are tried; one left out is never used. Resizing and the other geometry are sips's on macOS whenever it is listed; ImageMagick is the fallback for everything.

store.tagline: Compress, resize, convert and strip images, local first
features: The images at hand before you type: the Finder selection (a folder's images too), an image or files on the clipboard; a typed path lists a file, a folder or completions

Compress with pngquant, oxipng, mozjpeg (cjpeg), cwebp, avifenc, gifsicle, ImageMagick or sips, whichever the machine has, in the order you set; the row says which tool did it and the size before and after
Optimise for web: cap the long side, encode at the quality, strip what is left, as a view with the before and after of every image and the total saved

Resize (width, height, fit, percent, @2x and @1x), Convert (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, PDF, TIFF, GIF), Rotate and flip, Crop to an aspect centred or pad to a square, Grayscale, Strip metadata (lossless for PNG and JPEG)
Make an icon set: the .iconset, the .icns (iconutil), favicon.ico, and the touch and Android sizes, in a folder next to the image
Get info in the detail pane: dimensions, format, colour profile, camera, lens, exposure, date, location (exiftool when installed); Copy text (OCR) through the Vision framework or tesseract

Every result is written next to the source with a suffix (-compressed, @0.5x, .webp) and its path copied; the image itself when the input was the clipboard. Replace writes over the source and keeps the original for Restore
Several at once: the All row, marked rows, a folder; a long batch reports in the HUD when it lands. TinyPNG with an API key for the strongest compression

screenshots.caption: The images at hand: the Finder selection and the clipboard, each with its size and dimensions, the result of a compression under Results
Every operation on a row: compress, optimise for web, resize, convert, rotate, crop, strip, grayscale, icon set, OCR, info
The detail pane: the picture, dimensions, format, colour, camera and exposure
Resize: the presets and a typed size, each row saying the pixels it lands on
Convert: the formats, each row naming the tool that writes it, a missing tool named
Optimise for web: the before and after of every image, the saving as a tag, the total at the bottom

actions.title: Compress
actions.description: Lossy at the quality; the smaller of the encoders' results, or nothing when the file is already small.

actions.title: Optimise for web
actions.description: Cap the long side, encode, strip; a view with the before and after.

actions.title: Compress losslessly
actions.description: oxipng, jpegtran, cwebp -lossless, gifsicle: the pixels untouched.

actions.title: Resize…
actions.description: Presets, or a typed size: 800, x600, 800x600, 50%, 2x.

actions.title: Convert…
actions.description: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, PDF, TIFF, GIF.

actions.title: Crop or pad…
actions.description: Square, 16:9, 4:3, 3:2, 9:16 centred; pad to a square.

actions.title: Strip metadata
actions.description: EXIF, XMP, comments, the ICC profile; lossless for PNG and JPEG.

actions.title: Make an icon set
actions.description: A folder with the .iconset, .icns, favicon.ico and the web sizes.

actions.title: Copy info
actions.description: The detail pane's lines as text.

actions.title: Copy image
actions.description: The picture onto the clipboard (PNG and JPEG); other formats as a file.

actions.title: Restore original
actions.description: On a result that replaced its source.

images.description: The images selected in Finder, on the clipboard or at a typed path; every operation an action on a row, the results next to their sources.
